description: This file defines a class SkillsSandboxExecutor that manages executing skill code within a sandboxed environment using llm-sandbox. It handles setting up sandbox sessions, copying skill files, installing requirements, executing code, and collecting generated output files.

classes.name: SkillsSandboxExecutor
classes.description: A class that manages executing skill code in a sandbox environment, including file setup, requirements installation, code execution, and output collection.

methods.description: Scans the sandbox directory for output files that were not part of the original skill files, and encodes them for retrieval.
